summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing its November 12, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 results. Net income was $1.9 billion for the quarter and $5.3 billion for the last twelve months; distributable earnings before realizations reached $1.5 billion ($0.64/share) quarterly and a record $5.8 billion ($2.47/share) LTM, up 16% per share including realizations. Asset management raised $25 billion and fee-related earnings rose 15%. The release notes over $300 million of shares repurchased since the prior report, roughly $900 million year-to-date, an ongoing buyback rather than a discrete special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings current report with no deal to arbitrage.
